errors.evidence: The description omits the full context of what the chart represents, which is the "Share of trade in goods in GDP" (Дял на търговията със стоки в БВП), as specified in the figure's caption. It only states the values are percentages, without mentioning what they are a percentage of.

errors.text_span: достигат най-високи видими нива малко под 70,0% в периода 2006–2008 г.
errors.evidence: The highest levels for "внос" (import) are in 2006 and 2007 (approx. 68%). The value in 2008 is visibly lower (approx. 64%). Describing the entire 2006-2008 period as having the "highest visible levels" is an over-generalization, as it incorrectly implies a three-year plateau rather than a two-year peak followed by a decline.
